Can our classrooms go beyond AI theory and equip students with the knowledge to build with AI? 
 
At the #Huawei booth at #MWC26, smart education solutions show how schools can prepare students to stay at the forefront of the AI driven era. Through hands on learning, students can turn complex industry code into practical, real world experience.
 
Watch how young learners can directly build and test real AI systems, bridging classroom learning with real world application at MWC 2026 in Barcelona. #AdvancingIndustrialAllIntelligence
title: Huawei Advances AI Ready Classrooms with Smart Education Tools
